title: "Just Trickster"
description: A small pack containing trickster and addons with a few extra essential mods
body:
A modpack for trying out [Trickster](https://modrinth.com/mod/trickster) or for use as a base to make your own pack with [Trickster](https://modrinth.com/mod/trickster).

## Versions
The fabric version is recommended for trying out trickster. The neoforge version is only intended to be used as an example of trickster and addons working with [Sinytra Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector). **The neoforge version uses a [fork](https://github.com/Master-Bw3/owo-lib) of owolib! Do not report issues to wisp forest!!** 

Basically if you want to run neoforge mods alongside trickster either use the neoforge version of the pack or use the fabric version with [Kilt](https://modrinth.com/mod/kilt).

## Missing Addons & Itegerations
- [Sibyl](https://github.com/Master-Bw3/Sibyl): Personally not a huge fan. It might also be confusing to newer players. But if would like autocomplete in the spell screen I recommend it!
- [Trickster Lisp](https://modrinth.com/mod/trickster-lisp): I think it doesn't fit trickster very well. Though If you are someone who prefers writing their spells in more conventional it might be for you.
- [Random Acess Minds](https://modrinth.com/mod/random-access-mind): Not for the latest versions of trickster. Use the crowmind with a map instead.
- [Trickster Math](https://modrinth.com/mod/trickster-math-tricks): Does not support the latest version of trickster


I try to make sure it always stays up to date with the latest version of [Trickster](https://modrinth.com/mod/trickster) and addons!

For help with Trickster check the guidebook ([online version](https://trickster.ing/)) or ask in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/WcYsDDQtyR) or make a post on the [forum](https://forum.trickster.ing/).
(for spesfic problems related to the pack feel free to leave an issue or reply on the packs [forum post](https://forum.trickster.ing/viewtopic.php?t=28))
